name: Navidrome
description: Your own music streaming server, Subsonic-compatible.
compose:
services:
  navidrome:
    image: deluan/navidrome:latest
    container_name: navidrome
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:4533"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/data:/data
      - /srv/music:/music:ro
